name: decode_unicode_digit_falls_through_to_string
description: A bare token with a non-ASCII Unicode digit does not match the number grammar (DIGIT is ASCII 0-9, Section 2.3) and decodes as a string, never a number. Guards the cross-SDK losslessness defect where a Unicode-mode regex accepted 1.<U+0665> and a Unicode-folding number parse returned 1.5.
